oo::class: The class of all classes. `oo::class create Name ?script?` defines a class; the script holds constructor / method / superclass declarations.
所有类的类。`oo::class create 名字 ?脚本?` 定义一个类;脚本里写 constructor / method / superclass 等声明。
oo::object: The root class of all objects.
oo::define: Change a class: oo::define Foo {method bar {} {...}} or oo::define Foo method bar {} {...}.
修改一个类:oo::define Foo {method bar {} {...}} 或 oo::define Foo method bar {} {...}。
oo::objdefine: Change a single object (add methods, mixins, filters ...), not its class.
修改单个对象(增加方法、mixin、filter 等),而不是它的类。
oo::copy: Copy an object (or class); returns the new object.
复制一个对象(或类),返回新对象。
oo::configurable: Metaclass (Tcl 9.0) that gives classes `property` declarations and a configure method.
元类(Tcl 9.0):让类支持 property 声明和 configure 方法。

constructor: Constructor run by `new` / `create`. Its arguments are those given after the class name.
构造函数,在 new / create 时运行;参数就是类名之后给出的参数。
destructor: Run when the object is destroyed.
method: Define a method. Names starting with an upper-case letter are private (not exported) by default.
定义方法。名字以大写字母开头的方法默认是私有的(不导出)。
forward: Define a method that forwards to another command, with extra leading arguments.
定义转发到另一个命令的方法,可附加前置参数。
unexport: 让方法变为私有(只能通过 my 调用)。
filter: Methods run around every public method call.
在每次公开方法调用外层执行的过滤方法。
mixin: Classes whose methods are mixed in ahead of the class's own.
混入的类,其方法优先于本类自己的方法。
variable: Instance variables that are visible in every method without declaring them.
实例变量:在每个方法中无需声明即可使用。
deletemethod: Remove methods defined by the class.
self: Declare things on the class object itself, e.g. `self method create_default {} {...}` (class methods).
在类对象自身上声明,如 `self method ...`(类方法)。
private: Declare private members (Tcl 8.7/9.0): `private method name args body`, `private variable ...`.
声明私有成员(Tcl 8.7/9.0):`private method 名 参数 体`、`private variable ...`。
classmethod: Define a method on the class object itself (Tcl 9.0), same as `self method`.
在类对象自身上定义方法(Tcl 9.0),等同 `self method`。
class: Change the class of the object (objdefine).
initialise: Run a script in the class when it is defined (Tcl 9.0; also spelled initialize).
定义类时在类内执行的脚本(Tcl 9.0,也可拼作 initialize)。
definitionnamespace: 搜索定义命令的命名空间(Tcl 9.0)。

my: Call a method (also private ones) of this object.
调用当前对象的方法(包括私有方法)。
self: The object's name; subcommands: caller class filter method namespace next object target.
当前对象的名字;子命令:caller class filter method namespace next object target。
next: Call the next implementation of this method (e.g. the superclass's).
调用该方法的下一个实现(如父类中的同名方法)。
nextto: Call the implementation from a specific class in the chain.
调用调用链中指定类的实现。

caller: Object / class / method that called this method.
调用本方法的对象/类/方法。
class: Class that defines the running method.
filter: When called from a filter: its declaring info.
在过滤方法中:声明它的信息。
next: Info about the next method in the chain.
调用链中下一个方法的信息。
target: Info about the first method call (when called via a filter).
最初被调用的方法信息(通过过滤方法调用时)。

destroy: 销毁对象(运行析构函数)。
variable: Bring object variables into the caller's scope.
把对象变量引入调用者作用域。
varname: Fully-qualified name of an object variable (for -textvariable, trace ...).
对象变量的完整名字(用于 -textvariable、trace 等)。
eval: Evaluate a script in the object's namespace (unexported).
在对象的命名空间中执行脚本(默认不导出)。

create: Create an instance with a given name; arguments go to the constructor.
创建指定名字的实例;参数传给构造函数。
new: Create an instance with a generated name; returns the name.
创建名字自动生成的实例,返回名字。
createWithNamespace: Create an instance with a chosen name and namespace.
创建指定名字和命名空间的实例。
